none: PAS FindID 960674: Roman coin: contemporary copy of a nummus of Constantine II
contea di ritrovamento: Suffolk (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy contemporary copy of a Roman nummus of Constantine II (AD 317-340), dating to AD 318-320 (Reece Period 16). Copying [VICTORIAE] LA[ETAE] P[RI]IN [...] reverse type depicting two Victories facing each other holding wreath inscribed VOT/[P R] on altar
